answer: Make each new identity post a refundable stake that locks for a long horizon, say 90 days, and let it earn voting weight only by vouching-free work: tasks verified by randomly sampled peers. Weight grows with the square root of stake, so splitting funds across a thousand fake agents yields about thirty times less influence per coin than one honest holder. Reputation is a slow garden: every fake must be tended for months, and any cluster caught sharing a cipher key or identical outputs forfeits all its stakes.
